label: Subsistent wisdom and same-source intrinsic self-understanding bridge test
summary: Continued #1731 / draft #1855. Compared q.4 a.2's subsistent-esse whole-perfection route with productive-power eminent possession. Added Lean-only conditional adapters in WholePowerPerfection: pure wisdom plus whole-perfection gives Has g wisdom at the same OwnBeing source; the OPEN WisdomSelfCapacity bridge then gives a true self-directed capacity (CanApprehend, a declared primitive meaning the source's own ability, not a power to make another apprehend); the OPEN exercise-or-potency bridge (InPotency read as POTENCY_2, DEF-INDEPENDENT-POTENCY; under POTENCY_1 at the single understanding respect it is still not excluded middle, because the capacity and apprehension predicates are content-indexed and a source apprehending one of two self-directed contents is not in adopted potency; it would reduce to excluded middle, moving the weight into PureAct, only with a further OPEN identification of contents with content-indexed CanBe/InAct respects) and pure act yield actual self-apprehension; a distinct intrinsic cognitive-grounding bridge yields a positive intrinsic-self-knowledge profile; a further explicit recognition premise reaches unchanged GodHasIntellect. A weaker code-level GodHasIntellect route reaches capacity without requiring actual exercise or pure act. Actual-root application retains the very same ground/world/witness. Four joint Bool assignments keep the nonempty source, wisdom and a HasIntellect-labelled effect fixed while omitting each of the three bridges in turn, checked in Lean by wisdomSelfUnderstandingControls; the dormant-capacity case is a model only under POTENCY_2, and the productive-only case is a structural surrogate (causesIn is unused and the effect apprehends nothing). Compare the existing generic-respect result c55e2ce2 (intellectualPureActOperatesFromCapacity); the new variant is content-indexed to keep subject, aboutness target and grounding on the same g. The capacity reading of HAS_INTELLECT_1 is a reading choice shared with IntellectIsCapacityToUnderstand. The impersonal secondary-cognition rival is a standing alternative explanation; no independent justification for its source-level denial is identified. Independent semantic challenge (2026-11-23): three P1 and seven P2 findings repaired in the Lean doc comments, the note and this record. The content-sensitive-intentionality, pure-wisdom classification, root/GOD_4 application, and HasIntellect recognition remain open philosophical premises. No new root-route argument or source attribution; canonical research assessment in docs/notes/physical-ground-468.md#same-source-wisdom-to-intrinsic-self-understanding-2026-11-22-1731. Local articulation follow-up (docs/notes/physical-ground-468.md#unrestricted-actuality-and-intellectual-perfection-two-connected-local-support-arguments-2026-11-25-draft-continuation): a completed learner distinguishes grasp from acquisition but can remain dependent on a received form. One assigned act realizes two contents with different truth conditions only under stipulated apprehension. Articulation need not require one constituent per content. Next explain how this bearer itself grasps its lack of receipt and composition without receiving either content. The actual GOD_4 theorem uses exercise-or-potency, pure act, cognitive grounding and recognition of actual intrinsic self-knowledge. Recognition of capacity belongs to the separate capacity theorem. The independent semantic challenge and targeted recheck accepted the scoped #1986 follow-up at 155eb64ef465af39ab2159e44ca137fca99d66d0. The proposed extension must preserve this actual root’s positive profile. Understanding two contents in one act remains stipulated in the control. Capacity and actual self-knowledge retain distinct recognition premises. Follow-up 2026-11-27 (#2145 lane 1, attempt 7a8914c0): aptitudeIffExerciseAtPureAct shows that SelfCapacityExercisedOrPotent, pure act and ab esse ad posse make own self-directed capacity and actual apprehension coincide at an own-being source, excluding the dormant-capacity control; the #1892 impersonal eminence source satisfies those premises with no capacity, so the remaining question is whether intellect must be present at all (purity and the three explanations of its absence).
blocker: Philosophically unresolved: defend wisdom as an intrinsic pure perfection at the selected subsistent source, explain source-intrinsic intentional grounding rather than merely correct noncognitive signal production, give the CanApprehend primitive a constraint separating own capacity from productive power, and independently justify the restricted capacity-to-actual-apprehension bridge under POTENCY_2 without conflating active productive powers with passive potency.
